notes: This update records planning only and does not change implementation code.
The precision baseline fixes one grade track and two affix slots per item.
Precision-enhancement failures consume committed materials only and resolve the milestone.
The integrated POC must expose representative enhancement, lifecycle, market and world-system interactions.
POC_CONFIRMED values are test-slice values and are not production balance commitments.
Planning remains PLANNING_IN_PROGRESS until the exact command 기획 완료.
